description: This Java source file defines the WifiApControl class, which provides control over Wi-Fi Access Points (APs) on Android devices. It includes methods for enabling/disabling Wi-Fi hotspots, checking support, retrieving connected clients, and obtaining network addresses, primarily via reflection and system interfaces.

classes.name: WifiApControl
classes.description: Provides control over Wi-Fi Access Points, including enabling/disabling hotspots, checking status, retrieving configuration, and connected clients.

classes.name: WifiApControl.Client
classes.description: Represents a client connected to the Wi-Fi AP, including IP and MAC addresses.

classes.name: WifiApControl.ReachableClientListener
classes.description: Interface for callbacks when checking reachability of connected clients.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if Wi-Fi AP functionality is supported on the device.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton getter for WifiApControl instance, initializes reflection methods.

methods.name: isWifiApEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the Wi-Fi AP is currently enabled.

methods.name: getWifiApState
methods.description: Retrieves the current Wi-Fi AP state.

methods.name: setWifiApEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the Wi-Fi AP with specified configuration.

methods.name: getClients
methods.description: Returns a list of clients connected to the Wi-Fi AP.

methods.name: getReachableClients
methods.description: Checks reachability of connected clients and invokes callbacks.
